about: Player value profiles for Hot Stove GM. One entry per player whose value needs more than the projection and recent results give it: 'war' replaces his on-field value (wins), 'adj' moves his trade grade (-6..+6) for market demand, 'note' is one short line the GM can say, 'src' is where it comes from. Add entries as news and stats come in; never guess.

Shohei Ohtani.note: a two-way player: his pitching counts on top of his bat
Shohei Ohtani.src: FanGraphs 2027 projections (hitting 4.2 WAR + pitching 2.3 WAR) and 2025-26 results

Mason Miller.note: the most sought-after reliever on the market

Jacob Reimer.note: he was hurt for part of 2026 and hit the way he had in 2025 once he was healthy

Jonah Tong.note: the 2025 minor-league pitcher of the year; he spent 2026 learning new pitches, then finished well in Triple-A and in the majors
